display_long_description:
The Moveabout VR Tourism Experience “POV tourism”

Watching live-action 360 video in the POV tourism brings you a special tourism experience
The POV tourism is a  multi-viewpoint VR visual experience

Using the controller to shoot the floating gate or cube in space, you can warp place or perspective instantly
This is a completely new proactive live-action VR experience.

The POV tourism can be downloaded for free

Enjoy an innovative VR tourism experience!

The POV tourism is an evolution of immersive visual experience. The 360 video is recorded simultaneously by multiple 360 cameras. Viewers can freely move their viewpoints with the controller. You can watch the sights and viewpoints from anywhere you like. You can experience the same sights over and over again in a fresh way.
It's not just immersive like you're there, but you're able to manipulate the visual space yourself. That’s POV tourism!
